baselineAssessment.reason: Independent per-surface estimate of the initial scope: protocol+plan-diff validation 5, pure domain/closure/fingerprint 5, decisions/fold/index/migration 8, routing 3, gate prompt+decision command+CAS 8, recording integration+context injection 5, templates/skills 3, dashboard 8 (priced for uncertainty: slice 04 has no plan), run-state/docs 3 since tests belong to the items they validate

workItems.title: Define governance types, finding fingerprints, and pure closure validation
workItems.rationale: Adds a shared policy subsystem and canonical identity abstraction; +1 reflects that maintenance surface. Tests are included.

workItems.title: Add immutable review decisions, derived gates, governing-state fold, codecs, and index rebuild
workItems.rationale: Adds an authoritative record kind, deterministic fold, projection, and migration; +2 reflects persistent change points. Gate records/codecs are removed.

workItems.title: Extend reviewer protocol and validate exact introducing plan hunks
workItems.rationale: Adds top-level prior outcomes and full-patch validation while reusing plan-208 item fields; tests cover truncation and exact evidence.

workItems.title: Derive mode-aware routes, suppress resolved causes, and normalize `ready_with_corrections`
workItems.rationale: One pure matrix handles pinned advisory diagnostics, enforced routing, cause approvals, and adjacent-debt policy.

workItems.title: Implement typed human-gate prompt flow and gate-scoped decision CAS
workItems.rationale: Adds a cross-process concurrency boundary and CLI command group; +2 reflects that burden. Exports seams for later dashboard work.

workItems.title: Integrate governance with plan-208 recording and author/reviewer prompt context
workItems.rationale: Wraps `recordPlanReviewerStepWithSnapshot`, folds governing `B`, and injects decisions into both author and reviewer prompts.

workItems.title: Rewrite reviewer/author templates and plan-review skills for closure routing
workItems.rationale: Adds mode-conditional instructions, prior outcomes, governing-author context, and full-diff retrieval guidance.

workItems.title: Complete end-to-end compatibility, audit, follow-up handoff, and documentation coverage
workItems.rationale: Removes dashboard parity scope, validates CLI/process races, and records dashboard work as a post-slice-04 follow-up.
